info.title: Safeer local identity API
info.description: Local Safeer identity and company workspaces. No production hosting, real booking or money API. Section 04 adds authenticated cities and company route planning. Section 05 adds company-private buses, immutable seat-layout revisions and driver records; Section 06 adds company trip scheduling, assignments and publication; Section 07 adds anonymous read-only marketplace routes; no reservations or payments.

post.summary: Hold 1-10 seats with their travelers, all or none
post.description: Anonymous. No session is used; writes require the page origin and JSON. Limited to 120 seats per client address per 15 minutes. Repeating a key with the same seats returns the original hold.

key.description: Created by the browser. Makes retries idempotent and is the only way to reopen or release the hold; only its hash is stored.

mobile.description: Local Sudanese or international. Stored in international form and erased 90 days after the trip.

get.summary: Open a hold
get.description: Anonymous. No session is used; writes require the page origin and JSON. The reference alone opens nothing.

post.summary: Release a hold
post.description: Anonymous. No session is used; writes require the page origin and JSON. Releasing twice is harmless; a hold that has ended stays ended. Reference-and-mobile attempts share the lookup limits, and replies stay masked.

key.description: Created by the browser. Makes retries idempotent and is the only way to reopen or release the hold; only its hash is stored.

schema.description: Send either key or mobile, not both.
